"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ArrowRightIcon } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import casualImg from "./images/casual.webp" import ethnicImg from "./images/ethnic.webp" import festiveImg from "./images/festive.webp" import picksImg from "./images/picks.webp" import streetImg from "./images/street.webp" function assetSrc(asset: string | { src: string }) { return typeof asset === "string" ? asset : asset.src } const CATEGORIES = [ { name: "Up To 40% OFF", subtitle: "The colors of this season", img: assetSrc(ethnicImg), tag: "Sale", }, { name: "Fresh Looks", subtitle: "The colors of this season", img: assetSrc(festiveImg), tag: "New", }, { name: "Up To 30% OFF", subtitle: "The colors of this season", img: assetSrc(casualImg), tag: "Sale", }, { name: "Exclusive Fashion", subtitle: "The colors of this season", img: assetSrc(streetImg), tag: "Drop", }, { name: "Top Picks for Less", subtitle: "The colors of this season", img: assetSrc(picksImg), tag: "Pick", }, ] as const export default function ProductCategories({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"section">) { return (

Offer desk

Featured Categories

    {CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
  • {category.tag}

    {category.name}

    {category.subtitle}

    Explore
    • ))}
) }
